_note: DataSource:Server is an Easy Connect string (host:port/service) or a TNS alias. Oracle has no Server-plus-Database pair, so DataSource:Database is deliberately empty and is not read.
SqlAuthMode Integrated means a wallet or Kerberos and needs no vault secret; remove the KeyVault:Secrets entry if you use it.

The view must expose RECORD_ID, TITLE, STATUS, OWNER, BODY, LAST_MODIFIED, CLASSIFICATIONS, and IS_DELETED when SoftDeleteEnabled is true. CLASSIFICATIONS is a comma-separated list and may be empty; it feeds the Sensitivity mapping, which the engine applies.
The connector refuses the run if the view carries a VPD, Label Security or Data Redaction policy. That is deliberate and cannot be disabled - see docs/ROUTING-DECISIONS.md section 6.

This connector reads INCREMENTALLY from LAST_MODIFIED. That is a claim about the view: the column must be UTC, monotonic, and move on every change including bulk updates. Where it cannot, the connector must be changed to read in full rather than the column trusted.
